en: The Fifteenth Dynasty of Egypt as a foreign dynasty founded by Salitis during the Second Intermediate Period
Its rule from Avaris over Lower Egypt and its expulsion by the Theban Seventeenth Dynasty
zh: 埃及第十五王朝是第二中间期由萨利蒂斯建立的外来王朝
以阿瓦里斯为中心统治下埃及，后被底比斯第十七王朝驱逐

politics.zh: 埃及第十五王朝是第二中间期由萨利蒂斯建立的外来王朝，约公元前1650年起以阿瓦里斯为中心统治下埃及，其统治者通常被称为喜克索斯人。它控制尼罗河三角洲的农业与地中海东岸的贸易，向南方底比斯政权征收贡赋；约公元前1550年被底比斯第十七王朝的雅赫摩斯一世驱逐，埃及重新统一，新王国开始。
politics.en: The Fifteenth Dynasty of Egypt was a foreign dynasty founded by Salitis during the Second Intermediate Period, ruling Lower Egypt from Avaris from about 1650 BC, its rulers generally being called the Hyksos. It controlled the farming of the Nile delta and trade with the eastern Mediterranean and levied tribute on the Theban power in the south; around 1550 BC it was expelled by Ahmose I of the Theban Seventeenth Dynasty, Egypt was reunified and the New Kingdom began.

economy.zh: 经济以尼罗河三角洲的农业、地中海东岸贸易与手工业为基础，阿瓦里斯是港口与行政中心，与黎凡特城市的往来密切，谷物、纺织品与金属是重要交换物。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the Nile delta, trade with the eastern Mediterranean and crafts, with Avaris a port and administrative centre, close dealings with Levantine cities, and grain, textiles and metals among the goods exchanged.

culture.zh: 第十五王朝时期埃及与黎凡特的文化因素交融，三角洲地区出现迦南风格的建筑与器物，书写与宗教传统并存，考古发现显示贸易网络与移民社群的存在。
culture.en: In the period of the Fifteenth Dynasty Egyptian and Levantine cultural elements intermingled, Canaanite-style buildings and objects appearing in the delta, writing and religious traditions coexisting, and archaeological finds showing trade networks and immigrant communities.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约公元前1650年王朝在阿瓦里斯的建立、对下埃及与三角洲贸易的控制、与底比斯政权的长期对峙，以及约公元前1550年被雅赫摩斯一世驱逐，这些事件构成第二中间期的结束与新王国的开始。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the dynasty at Avaris around 1650 BC, its control of Lower Egypt and delta trade, the long confrontation with the Theban power and its expulsion by Ahmose I around 1550 BC, events that make up the end of the Second Intermediate Period and the beginning of the New Kingdom.

en: The Sixteenth Dynasty of Egypt as a dynasty of pharaohs during the Second Intermediate Period
Its rule from Thebes alongside the Hyksos Fifteenth Dynasty and its absorption into the Theban revival
zh: 埃及第十六王朝是第二中间期的王朝
以底比斯为中心与喜克索斯第十五王朝并立，后并入底比斯复兴

politics.zh: 埃及第十六王朝是第二中间期的王朝，约公元前1650年起以底比斯为中心统治上埃及，与北方的第十五王朝并立。它由本地王统统治，控制上埃及的农业与神庙经济，与南方库什及北方喜克索斯势力互动；其统治逐步被第十七王朝取代，底比斯势力最终完成驱逐喜克索斯人与统一埃及的事业。
politics.en: The Sixteenth Dynasty of Egypt was a dynasty of the Second Intermediate Period that ruled Upper Egypt from Thebes from about 1650 BC alongside the Fifteenth Dynasty in the north. Ruled by a local royal line, it controlled the farming and temple economy of Upper Egypt and interacted with Kush in the south and the Hyksos power in the north; its rule was gradually replaced by the Seventeenth Dynasty, whose Theban power finally expelled the Hyksos and reunified Egypt.

economy.zh: 经济以上埃及的尼罗河农业、神庙经济与努比亚方向的贸易为基础，底比斯的神庙占有土地与资源，谷物、亚麻与黄金是重要产品，与南方的贸易带来香料与矿产。
economy.en: The economy rested on Nile farming in Upper Egypt, the temple economy and trade towards Nubia, with the temples of Thebes holding land and resources, grain, flax and gold among the important products, and trade with the south bringing incense and minerals.

culture.zh: 第十六王朝时期底比斯的宗教与葬仪传统延续，神庙与墓葬留下遗存，埃及艺术与文字保持传统风格，与努比亚及黎凡特的文化接触见于考古发现。
culture.en: In the period of the Sixteenth Dynasty the religious and funerary traditions of Thebes continued, temples and tombs surviving as remains, Egyptian art and writing keeping their traditional forms, and cultural contact with Nubia and the Levant known from archaeology.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约公元前1650年王朝在底比斯的建立、与第十五王朝的并立、上埃及神庙经济的发展，以及其统治被第十七王朝取代，这些事件构成第二中间期底比斯政权演变的历史。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the dynasty at Thebes around 1650 BC, its coexistence with the Fifteenth Dynasty, the development of the temple economy of Upper Egypt and the replacement of its rule by the Seventeenth Dynasty, events that make up the history of the Theban polity during the Second Intermediate Period.

value.zh: 其统治逐步被第十七王朝取代。
value.en: Its rule was gradually replaced by the Seventeenth Dynasty.

en: The Tangier International Zone as a territory in Morocco under international administration
Its existence from 1923 to 1956 and its return to Moroccan sovereignty
zh: 丹吉尔国际区是摩洛哥境内由国际共管的地区
1923至1956年存在，后回归摩洛哥主权

politics.zh: 丹吉尔国际区是摩洛哥境内由国际共管的地区，1923年由法国、西班牙与英国等国协议设立，由多国委员会与管理者治理，实行自由贸易与货币自由兑换。它成为国际金融与谍报活动的重要地点，二战期间一度被西班牙占领；1956年摩洛哥独立后，该区于同年回归摩洛哥主权。
politics.en: The Tangier International Zone was a territory in Morocco under international administration established by agreement among France, Spain, Britain and others in 1923, governed by a multinational committee and an administrator with free trade and free currency convertibility. It became an important centre of international finance and intelligence activity and was briefly occupied by Spain during the Second World War; after Moroccan independence in 1956 the zone returned to Moroccan sovereignty the same year.

economy.zh: 经济以自由贸易、转口贸易、金融服务与旅游业为基础，丹吉尔港是地中海与大西洋之间的转运节点，免税与货币自由政策吸引国际商业，走私与投机活动亦见于记载。
economy.en: The economy rested on free trade, transit trade, financial services and tourism, with the port of Tangier a transit point between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic, tax exemption and free currency policies attracting international business, and smuggling and speculation also being recorded.

culture.zh: 丹吉尔国际区时期多元社群并存，阿拉伯、西班牙、法国与国际侨民共处，咖啡馆与文学沙龙活跃，建筑融合摩尔与欧洲风格，音乐与报刊文化具有国际色彩。
culture.en: In the period of the international zone plural communities coexisted, Arab, Spanish, French and international residents living together, its cafes and literary salons active, its architecture combining Moorish and European styles, and its music and press having an international flavour.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1923年国际共管协议的设立、自由贸易体制的运行、二战期间西班牙的占领，以及1956年摩洛哥独立后回归主权，这些事件决定了丹吉尔的现代归属。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the international administration by agreement in 1923, the working of the free trade regime, the Spanish occupation during the Second World War and the return to Moroccan sovereignty after independence in 1956, events that determined the modern allegiance of Tangier.

value.en: International administration was established by agreement in 1923.
It returned to Moroccan sovereignty in 1956.

en: Libya, officially the State of Libya, as a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa
Its Mediterranean coastline and its borders with Egypt, Sudan, Chad, Niger, Algeria and Tunisia
zh: 利比亚正式称利比亚国，是北非马格里布地区国家
临地中海，邻埃及、苏丹、乍得、尼日尔、阿尔及利亚与突尼斯

politics.zh: 利比亚国是北非马格里布地区国家，临地中海，邻埃及、苏丹、乍得、尼日尔、阿尔及利亚与突尼斯，首都为的黎波里。它有古代腓尼基与希腊殖民地、罗马与奥斯曼统治的历史，1911年后由意大利统治，1951年独立为王国，1969年成为共和国；2011年后陷入分裂与冲突，政治过渡仍未完成。
politics.en: Libya, officially the State of Libya, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa on the Mediterranean, bordered by Egypt, Sudan, Chad, Niger, Algeria and Tunisia, with Tripoli as its capital. It has a history of Phoenician and Greek colonies and of Roman and Ottoman rule, was ruled by Italy after 1911 and became an independent kingdom in 1951 and a republic in 1969; after 2011 it fell into division and conflict and its political transition is still incomplete.

economy.zh: 经济以石油与天然气出口、农业与服务业为基础，石油与天然气占出口与财政的绝大部分，绿洲农业与畜牧业依赖地下水，冲突严重破坏基础设施与产量。
economy.en: The economy rests on oil and gas exports, farming and services, with oil and gas accounting for the great majority of exports and public revenue, oasis farming and herding depending on groundwater, and the conflict having severely damaged infrastructure and output.

culture.zh: 利比亚文化以阿拉伯语、伊斯兰传统与柏柏尔社群文化为基础，莱普提斯与昔兰尼等考古遗址被列为世界遗产，音乐与手工艺传统延续，绿洲城镇与地中海沿岸城市各有特色。
culture.en: Libyan culture rests on the Arabic language, Islamic tradition and Amazigh communal culture, archaeological sites such as Leptis Magna and Cyrene being World Heritage, its music and crafts continuing, and its oasis towns and Mediterranean cities each having a distinctive character.

events.zh: 关键节点包括古代殖民地与罗马统治、1911年后意大利统治、1951年独立与1969年共和国建立，以及2011年后的分裂与冲突，这些事件塑造了现代利比亚。
events.en: Key moments are the ancient colonies and Roman rule, Italian rule after 1911, independence in 1951 and the republic of 1969 and the division and conflict after 2011, events that have shaped modern Libya. Its oil wealth and Mediterranean position keep it central to regional politics.

value.en: It became an independent kingdom in 1951.

value.zh: 莱普提斯与昔兰尼等遗址为世界遗产。
value.en: Sites such as Leptis Magna and Cyrene are World Heritage.

en: South Yemen, officially the People's Democratic Republic of Yemen, as a state in the south of the Arabian peninsula
Its existence from 1967 to 1990 and its unification with North Yemen
zh: 也门民主人民共和国通称南也门，是阿拉伯半岛南部的国家

politics.zh: 也门民主人民共和国通称南也门，是阿拉伯半岛南部的国家，1967年由南阿拉伯联邦的民族解放运动取得独立后建立，以亚丁为都。它是阿拉伯世界唯一公开以马克思主义为指导的国家，实行国有化与土地改革，与苏联及东欧国家关系密切；1990年与北也门统一为也门共和国，1994年内战失败后其政治传统终结。
politics.en: South Yemen, officially the People's Democratic Republic of Yemen, was a state in the south of the Arabian peninsula established in 1967 after the nationalist movement won independence from the Federation of South Arabia, with Aden as its capital. It was the only state in the Arab world openly guided by Marxism, carrying out nationalisation and land reform and maintaining close relations with the Soviet Union and Eastern Europe; in 1990 it was unified with North Yemen as the Republic of Yemen and after defeat in the civil war of 1994 its political tradition came to an end.

economy.zh: 经济以亚丁港的转口贸易、渔业、农业与苏联及东欧援助为基础，亚丁是区域航运与炼油中心，渔业与棉花是重要物产，国有化与计划经济影响经济结构。
economy.en: The economy rested on transit trade through the port of Aden, fishing, farming and aid from the Soviet Union and Eastern Europe, with Aden a regional shipping and refining centre, fish and cotton among the important products, and nationalisation and central planning shaping its economic structure.

culture.zh: 南也门时期推行世俗教育与妇女权益改革，报刊与文学活动活跃，亚丁的多元城市文化延续，阿拉伯语与地方语言并用，部落传统与国家意识形态之间长期存在张力。
culture.en: In the period of South Yemen secular education and reforms concerning women's rights were promoted, the press and literary activity were lively, the plural urban culture of Aden continued, Arabic and local languages were both used, and tension persisted between tribal tradition and state ideology.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1967年独立建国、1970年代的社会经济改革、1986年内部分裂与武装冲突，以及1990年与北也门统一，这些事件构成南也门的兴衰史。
events.en: Key moments are independence and statehood in 1967, the social and economic reforms of the 1970s, the internal division and armed conflict of 1986 and unification with North Yemen in 1990, events that make up the rise and fall of South Yemen.

value.en: It became independent and a state in 1967.
It was unified with North Yemen in 1990.

en: The Sosso Empire, also written Soso or Susu, or alternatively Kaniaga, as a kingdom in West Africa
Its rise after the decline of Ghana and its conquest by Sundiata Keita of Mali
zh: 苏苏王国又称卡尼亚加，是西非的王国
在加纳衰落后兴起，后被马里的松迪亚塔征服

politics.zh: 苏苏王国又称卡尼亚加，是西非的王国，12世纪在加纳帝国衰落后由索索人建立，位于今马里西部一带，以库姆比萨莱赫等为中心。它由苏马古鲁·坎特等统治者领导，征服加纳故地并向周边征收贡赋，控制撒哈拉商路；约1235年在基里纳战役中被马里的松迪亚塔击败，其地并入马里帝国。
politics.en: The Sosso Empire, also written Soso or Susu, or alternatively Kaniaga, was a kingdom in West Africa established by the Sosso people in the twelfth century after the decline of the Ghana empire, in what is now western Mali with Kumbi Saleh and other centres. Led by rulers such as Soumaoro Kante, it conquered the former Ghana lands, levied tribute on its neighbours and controlled the Saharan trade routes; around 1235 it was defeated at the battle of Kirina by Sundiata Keita of Mali and its lands were incorporated into the Mali empire.

economy.zh: 经济以萨赫勒地区的农业、畜牧与撒哈拉商路贸易为基础，控制黄金与盐的转运是重要财源，谷物、牲畜与布匹是重要交换物，商队税收支撑王室财政。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming and herding in the Sahel and on trade along the Saharan routes, with control of the transit of gold and salt an important source of revenue, grain, livestock and cloth among the goods exchanged, and caravan dues supporting royal finances.

culture.zh: 苏苏王国时期萨赫勒地区的口传传统与伊斯兰接触并存，铁匠与音乐家阶层在社会中地位重要，史诗与格里奥传统记录了与马里的战争，建筑与聚落遗址留下考古遗存。
culture.en: In the period of the Sosso kingdom Sahelian oral tradition coexisted with contact with Islam, blacksmith and musician groups holding an important place in society, epic and griot tradition recording the war with Mali, and buildings and settlement sites leaving archaeological remains.

events.zh: 关键节点包括12世纪王国的建立、对加纳故地的征服与贡赋征收、撒哈拉商路的控制，以及约1235年在基里纳战役中被马里击败，这些事件构成西非帝国更替的历史。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the kingdom in the twelfth century, its conquest of the former Ghana lands and levy of tribute, its control of the Saharan routes and its defeat by Mali at Kirina around 1235, events that make up the history of the succession of West African empires.

value.en: It lay in what is now western Mali.

value.zh: 约1235年在基里纳战役中被马里击败。
value.en: It was defeated by Mali at the battle of Kirina around 1235.

en: The People's Republic of Zanzibar as a short-lived state in East Africa
Its existence in 1964 and its union with Tanganyika to form Tanzania
zh: 桑给巴尔人民共和国是东非的短暂政权
1964年存在，后与坦噶尼喀联合组成坦桑尼亚

politics.zh: 桑给巴尔人民共和国是东非的短暂政权，1964年1月由非洲-设拉子党在推翻桑给巴尔苏丹国后建立，由阿贝德·卡鲁梅领导。它推行土地与社会改革，与新独立的坦噶尼喀谈判联合；1964年4月与坦噶尼喀合并组成坦桑尼亚联合共和国，桑给巴尔保留自己的政府与议会，其自治地位延续至今。
politics.en: The People's Republic of Zanzibar was a short-lived state in East Africa established in January 1964 by the Afro-Shirazi Party after the overthrow of the Sultanate of Zanzibar, led by Abeid Karume. It carried out land and social reforms and negotiated union with the newly independent Tanganyika; in April 1964 the two merged to form the United Republic of Tanzania, Zanzibar keeping its own government and assembly and its autonomous status continuing to this day.

economy.zh: 经济以丁香与椰子出口、渔业、香料贸易与港口服务为基础，桑给巴尔是世界主要丁香产地，港口连接东非大陆与阿拉伯半岛及印度洋市场，土地改革改变了种植园所有权。
economy.en: The economy rested on clove and coconut exports, fishing, the spice trade and port services, with Zanzibar a leading world producer of cloves, its harbour linking the East African mainland with the Arabian peninsula and Indian Ocean markets, and land reform changing the ownership of plantations.

culture.zh: 桑给巴尔文化融合斯瓦希里、阿拉伯、印度与非洲传统，斯瓦希里语为通用语言，石头城被列为世界遗产，塔拉布音乐与木雕工艺著名，伊斯兰教与多社群文化并存。
culture.en: Zanzibari culture combines Swahili, Arab, Indian and African traditions, Swahili is the common language, Stone Town being listed as World Heritage, taarab music and woodcarving well known, and Islam existing alongside a plural communal culture.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1964年1月革命与人民共和国的建立、土地与社会改革的推行、与坦噶尼喀的联合谈判，以及1964年4月组成坦桑尼亚联合共和国，这些事件决定了桑给巴尔的现代地位。
events.en: Key moments are the revolution and the establishment of the people's republic in January 1964, the carrying out of land and social reforms, the negotiations on union with Tanganyika and the formation of the United Republic of Tanzania in April 1964, events that determined the modern status of Zanzibar.

value.en: It was established after the revolution of January 1964.

value.zh: 1964年4月与坦噶尼喀组成坦桑尼亚。
value.en: In April 1964 it merged with Tanganyika to form Tanzania.

en: Zaire, officially the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as the name of the country from 1971 to 1997
Its rule under Mobutu and its renaming after the First Congo War
zh: 扎伊尔是1971至1997年刚果民主共和国使用的国名
由蒙博托统治，第一次刚果战争后改回原国名

politics.zh: 扎伊尔是1971至1997年刚果民主共和国使用的国名，由蒙博托·塞塞·塞科在1971年推行“真实性”政策时改名，首都为金沙萨。他实行一党制与个人统治，将矿业收归国有并与西方及苏联阵营周旋，经济在1970年代后因铜价下跌与腐败而衰退；1997年第一次刚果战争推翻其政权，国名恢复为刚果民主共和国。
politics.en: Zaire was the name of the Democratic Republic of the Congo from 1971 to 1997, adopted by Mobutu Sese Seko in 1971 under his policy of authenticity, with Kinshasa as its capital. He ruled through a single party and personal power, nationalised the mining industry and manoeuvred between the western and Soviet blocs, and the economy declined after the 1970s through falling copper prices and corruption; in 1997 the First Congo War overthrew his regime and the country's name reverted to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

economy.zh: 经济以铜、钴与钻石等矿产出口、农业与河运为基础，矿业是财政核心，铜价波动直接影响国家收入，国有化与腐败削弱了生产与投资，农业与基础设施长期衰退。
economy.en: The economy rested on exports of copper, cobalt and diamonds together with farming and river transport, with mining at the core of public finances, copper prices directly affecting state revenue, nationalisation and corruption weakening production and investment, and farming and infrastructure declining over the long term.

culture.zh: 扎伊尔时期推行“真实性”文化政策，恢复本地姓名与服饰，音乐与舞蹈传统影响非洲广泛地区，伦巴与苏库斯音乐繁荣，文学与绘画具有国际影响，教会与社会组织在公共生活中作用重要。
culture.en: In the Zaire period the policy of authenticity promoted local names and dress, its music and dance traditions influencing much of Africa, rumba and soukous flourishing, its literature and painting having international influence, and churches and social organisations playing an important part in public life.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1965年蒙博托掌权、1971年改国名为扎伊尔、1970年代的国有化与经济衰退，以及1997年第一次刚果战争推翻政权并恢复国名，这些事件塑造了现代刚果民主共和国的历史。
events.en: Key moments are the coming to power of Mobutu in 1965, the change of the country's name to Zaire in 1971, the nationalisation and economic decline of the 1970s and the overthrow of the regime in the First Congo War of 1997 with the restoration of the former name, events that have shaped the history of the modern Democratic Republic of the Congo.

value.en: The country was renamed Zaire in 1971.

value.zh: 1997年第一次刚果战争后恢复原国名。
value.en: After the First Congo War of 1997 the former name was restored.
